# Wrenfold — art handoff for ChatGPT

*Generated by `node tools/art-handoff.js` from the plan and the script, so it always matches the story. Everything here is new; nothing is reused from Calder.*

## Style

- **The same family as Calder's art**: painted pixel art, 16-bit-era detail, hand-placed pixels, limited palette per image, soft dithering in gradients, no vector smoothness. Warm, storybook, a little melancholy.
- **The feel**: merry, wondrous, candlelit (the Lantern Hall's floating lanterns are the signature image), with a real dark edge (the Grey Choir: grey hoods, humming, colour drained).
- **Portraits**: head and shoulders, three-quarter or front view, on a **transparent background**, 1122 × 1402 masters (4:5) are ideal; the game exports them to 256 × 320. Same framing for everyone: top of the head near the top, shoulders at the bottom edge. Students wear their house colours (Larkspire gold and rose; Owlcombe plum and silver; Heronmere sea-green and pearl; Rookhallow black and copper). Expressions keep the **same face and outfit**, only the expression changes.
- **Places**: 16:9, 1672 × 941 masters are ideal; the game exports 640 × 360. No people in them unless noted (the story adds portraits).
- **Files**: name them exactly as listed and put them in `art/masters/portraits/`, `art/masters/environments/` and `art/masters/cinematic/`. `python3 tools/import-art.py` does the rest.

## 1. You (the player)

Twelve portraits: **witch** and **wizard**, each in six skin tones. Mid-twenties, friendly, an ordinary face that could be anyone's; a warm jumper under an open plain black robe (the house lining shows as a thin neutral grey, so it works for every house). Hair: shoulder-length and soft for the witch, short and a bit untidy for the wizard, dark brown for the lighter tones and black for the darker ones. Neutral expression only.

## 2. Familiars

One portrait each, same 4:5 framing, the animal filling the frame warmly, on a transparent background. Chosen by the player in Chapter 2; shown when it's named and whenever it does something.

| `fam-fox.png` | a young fox kit, russet and white, one black-socked paw |

| `fam-toad.png` | a fat, magnificently green toad with golden eyes |
| `fam-moth.png` | a luna moth the size of a hand, pale green, faintly glowing, long tails on its wings |

## 3. The cast

Each person's **appearance line** is the brief. Draw every expression listed; the list is taken from the script (expressions marked *(planned)* aren't in the written chapters yet but will be).

### Rowan Ashby (C01, lead, larkspire)

Tall, broad-shouldered, open square face with a strong jaw and a slightly crooked nose (broken twice). Short copper-red hair, freckles everywhere, light skin that flushes easily. Warm brown eyes. Rolled-up sleeves, forearms with old burn-scar shine; Larkspire gold-and-rose scarf.

- `c01-rowan-neutral.png`: resting face, the default
- `c01-rowan-warm.png`: a soft real smile
- `c01-rowan-amused.png`: a wry or delighted grin

- `c01-rowan-tense.png`: worried, jaw set

## 4. Places

Each place has a main picture and, where the story needs them, variants (a season, a festival, a darker night). **39 places.**

| File | Place | Brief |
|---|---|---|
| `home-kitchen.png` | 7 Viaduct Street (Wrexley) | Your narrow rented house under the railway viaduct: a kitchen with a yellow light, steep stairs, a front door with a draught under it, a back yard with one tomato plant. Trains shake the cups. |
| `home-street-night.png` | 7 Viaduct Street, variant | Viaduct Street at night in the rain, the viaduct overhead, one lit window |
| `nana-pearl.png` | Nana Pearl's bungalow (Wrexley) | Across town: lavender and toast, a budgie called Admiral, net curtains, a telly always on quietly, photographs of you at every age. |
| `work.png` | Your work (Wrexley) | Wherever you worked (chosen in CH01): a call-centre floor, A&E reception, a pub kitchen, a department-store returns desk, the town library, a courier depot. Strip lights, a clock that's always slow. |
| `lamplight-row.png` | Lamplight Row (Lamplight Row) | A hidden street of all-night shops, reached through a door in a Kingsmere bus shelter: crooked gables, hanging lamps in every colour, cobbles, a smell of toffee and ozone, owls on the gutters. |
| `wrens-nest.png` | The Wren's Nest (Lamplight Row) | Wrenfold's welcome office: a tall narrow shopfront full of pigeonholes, forms that fold themselves, a kettle, a sleepy wren on the counter, and Mr Fitch. |
| `wand-shop.png` | Pellow & Daughters, Wandwrights (Lamplight Row) | Drawers of wands to the ceiling, ladders, sawdust, a workbench with glowing shavings, a bell that rings before the door opens. |
| `robe-shop.png` | Hask & Needle (Lamplight Row) | Bolts of cloth in house colours, mirrors that show you from behind, a gossiping tape measure. |
| `menagerie.png` | The Menagerie (Lamplight Row) | Familiars in baskets, cages with open doors, a sleepy fox, a hundred owls, hay, incense, a warm dark. |
| `lamp-ladle.png` | The Lamp & Ladle (Lamplight Row) | All-night café-inn: soup in bowls the size of hubcaps, mismatched chairs, a fire, a cat on every table. |
| `platform-nought.png` | Platform Nought (Kingsmere) | Under Kingsmere Central through a luggage office: a gaslit platform, the Lantern Train in green and gold, steam, trunks, familiars in carriers, goodbyes. |
| `mere-night.png` | Wrenfold Mere and the Boathouse (Wrenfold) | A long black lake in the hills; the castle on its wooded island; the old boathouse with lantern-boats that row themselves. Freezes at Longnight. |
| `mere-frozen.png` | Wrenfold Mere and the Boathouse, variant | the Mere frozen white under stars, the castle lit, lanterns on the ice (Longnight, Candlewake) |
| `mere-day.png` | Wrenfold Mere and the Boathouse, variant | the Mere on a bright autumn day, boats at the jetty |
| `boathouse.png` | Wrenfold Mere and the Boathouse, variant | the old boathouse inside: lantern-boats on the black water, a stone stair up into the rock |
| `lantern-hall.png` | The Lantern Hall (Wrenfold) | Ten thousand paper lanterns drifting under a roof no one's seen; four long house tables; High Table under a great round window; the four roosts in the high corners. The heart of the school. |
| `lantern-hall-emberfall.png` | The Lantern Hall, variant | the Hall at Emberfall: every lantern burning red and orange, masks, apple-fire |
| `lantern-hall-longnight.png` | The Lantern Hall, variant | the Hall at Longnight midnight: every lantern burning blue, snow at the great window, the Dance |
| `lantern-hall-dark.png` | The Lantern Hall, variant | the Hall in the Quiet: the lanterns guttering grey, shadows, broken tables |
| `larkspire.png` | Larkspire Tower (Wrenfold) | Larkspire's round common room at the top of the east tower: cushions, gold-and-rose hangings, a balcony that catches the dawn, a piano nobody can play. |
| `owlcombe.png` | The Owlcombe Stacks (Wrenfold) | Owlcombe's common room under the Observatory: shelves and ladders, armchairs, a ceiling of real night sky, plum and silver. |
| `heronmere.png` | The Heronmere Cloister (Wrenfold) | Heronmere's common room half under the Mere: green water-light through tall windows, fish going by, sea-green cushions, a still pool. |
| `rookhallow.png` | The Rookhallow Undercroft (Wrenfold) | Rookhallow's common room beneath the kitchens: warm stone, forges, workbenches, half-built contraptions, copper and black. |
| `classroom.png` | The Wordcraft Gallery (Wrenfold) | A long classroom with tall windows, desks carved with four hundred years of initials, chalk spells on the board, floating feathers. |
